Chimera Creator · Research Report 01

Image Model Bakeoff

Three chimera specs, four contenders, one question: which model can render a movie-quality monster on a genuinely transparent background, fast enough for a seven-year-old's attention span?

Verdict
RoleModelLatencyWhy
Hero creature render (runtime)gpt-image-1.5 · high · transparent ~50sOnly native-alpha model. Translucent flame wings, lightning, and water spray keep real partial transparency — chroma-key physically can't do this. Best creature drama of all four.
Fast path (if ever needed)gpt-image-1.5 · medium · transparent ~26sTransparency verified at the pixel level; near-hero quality at half the wait.
Creature record — name, stats, abilitiesgpt-5.1 structured output ~16sBest fused abilities and honest weaknesses; kid-perfect copy.
Championship key artgpt-image-1.5 · images.edit ~74sTwo saved heroes composed into one battle scene with identities intact — the spec's biggest flagged risk, solved.
Pregenerated UI & environment artgemini-3-pro-image ~24sAgora-proven pipeline; opaque art doesn't need alpha.
Degradation pathgemini-3.1-flash-image / gemini-3-flash 12s / 9sIf OpenAI is down, the game still works.

The transparency test

Each sheet shows the same creature spec across all four models, composited over a neon-lab gradient — exactly how the game will present them. Columns: gpt-image-2 (chroma-key), gpt-image-1.5 (native alpha), gemini-3-pro-image (chroma-key), gemini-3.1-flash-image (chroma-key).

Stormback Leviadrake (Dragon + Stegosaurus + Electric Eel + Shark). gpt-image-1.5 smoke breath and lightning survive as real translucency. Every chroma column shows magenta contamination around the glow effects.

Basilodion (Basilisk + Megalodon + Lobster + Electric Eel). The native-alpha column keeps the breaking wave and electric tail; chroma columns leave magenta blotches inside the lightning arcs.

Tideburn Aurion (Phoenix + Saber-Toothed Tiger + Walrus + Salmon). Flame wings are the hardest case: gpt-image-2's flood-fill left a magenta hole between body and tail; gpt-image-1.5's fire reads as fire.

Identity preservation — the big unlock

Both saved hero cutouts were fed to images.edit with a storm-coast battle prompt. Plates, pincers, colors, and eyes all match the originals. This is how championship finals get one-of-a-kind key art without creature drift.

Finals key art — Stormback vs Basilodion, generated from their saved renders.

Medium-quality render composited in-game style — 26 seconds. The transparency scare was a viewer artifact; pixel inspection shows a clean alpha channel.

What this settles

  • OpenAI wins the runtime loop (your bias held): gpt-image-1.5 for renders, gpt-5.1 for creature records and battle reasoning.
  • Gemini keeps the pregen pipeline: environments, UI chrome, and source-creature portraits reuse the Agora assetlib flow.
  • gpt-image-2 is out: no transparent-background support (API 400), and its chroma fallback contaminates glow effects.
  • Staged reveal fits the budget: record at ~16s, hero at ~50s — name and stats appear while the fusion chamber finishes the render.
